title: unified-rollouts-integrated-shadow-ab-canary-autorollback-workflow
author: Priya Natarajan
description:
Motivation: Bring canary, A/B and shadow traffic into a single integrated rollout workflow with deterministic auto-rollback behavior and improved observability. This PR implements a coordinated controller and runtime hooks so that staged canaries and shadow/A-B probes share metric extraction, quarantine handling and a unified auto-rollback decision engine.

What this change does: Implements a new autorollback workflow that: 1) accepts multi-stage canary weights (0->10->50->100), 2) supports parallel A/B variants with per-variant SLOs, 3) attaches shadow probing traffic and aggregates probe metrics with the same metric namespace used by live traffic, 4) introduces a quarantine stage and metric quorum to avoid noisy single-metric flips, and 5) wires new telemetry and tracing spans for rollback decision paths.

Key design notes: The rollout controller exposes a compatibility layer so existing rollout specs continue to work. New fields are opt-in: "probeQuota", "quarantineWindowSeconds", and "compositeMetricRules". Rollout decisions evaluate a composite metric that supports weighted thresholds and quorum over multiple signals (latency P99, error rate, token-quality regressions from eval probes). The runtime includes a fast path for ephemeral shadow probes to avoid KV cache pollution.

Files touched are focused on controller, autorollback engine, runtime hook and e2e tests. No changes to public REST API surface; rollout spec extensions are additive.

Checklist:
- [x] Controller: staged weight progression and A/B variant support
- [x] Runtime: shadow probe isolation + KV cache protection
- [x] Autorollback engine: composite metric evaluation + quarantine
- [x] Observability: new traces, metrics, and rollout dashboard panels
- [x] E2E: stability guards and preflight tests for common failure modes
- [x] Docs: rollout spec fields documented in redwood-docs (separate docs PR linked)

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests for composite metric evaluation and quorum logic added.
- Integration tests simulate noisy metrics and validate quarantine behavior.
- E2E preflight that runs canary progression against a simulated model variant with injected regressions; verified auto-rollback triggers and full restore path.

Rollout plan: Feature is behind a feature flag (unifiedRolloutsV2). We'll enable in staging, run canaries against a synthetic traffic profile for 48h, verify telemetry and alerts, then schedule gradual enablement for dedicated customers.

Compatibility and migration: Existing rollout YAMLs unaffected. New fields will be ignored by older controllers. Documentation PR (redwood-docs#542) contains examples and recommended probe sets.

Risks and mitigations: Composite metrics reduce sensitivity to noisy signals but may delay rollback; quarantine window defaults are conservative. E2E tests target known flaky scenarios and guard against false-positives.

References: Linear ENG-4821 (design), ENG-4890 (e2e), linked docs PR and dashboard changes.
